name: sub-human-repo
description: Dev scripts for the sub-human Claude Code plugin. The plugin's dependencies are vendored under plugin/sub-human/vendor; the devDependencies here only check its types and lint it.

scripts.test: npm run --silent typecheck && npm run --silent test:node && npm run --silent test:scripts && npm run --silent test:module
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
